items.name: urc-base-station-controller
items.description: Base Station Controller for Astra Robotics URC Rover

items.name: AI-Vision-Robotics
items.description: Object detection, model training, and Astra depth-driven robot control

items.name: astra-control-dashboard
items.description: GPT-6 Astra direct robot control on robomimic: results, videos, prompts (robocore.vlm_control)

items.name: AstraBot
items.description: Object-oriented C project for AstraBot, a modular autonomous robot simulation with sensors, display, and button controls.

items.name: ASTRA-Arm-Base-Station
items.description: A web based base station for all your robot arm control needs.

items.name: ASTRA
items.description: ASTRA — an astronaut-styled ROS 2 robot that navigates a simulated spacecraft and grabs/fixes parts on natural-language command, built with Nav2, MoveIt-style arm control, and an LLM command interface.

items.name: IX-ASTRA
items.description: A containment-first AGI architecture built for safe, auditable, real-time control of autonomous machines—featuring infiltrator agents, energy-aware logic, and BCI/robotics integration. Designed with Elon-level concerns in mind. Fully open-source. No blind spots.

items.name: astra_ihm_frontend
items.description: IHM based on Foxglove for perception purpose, controlling robot, perform missions etc.. You are free to fork it and custom modify it for your specific use case

items.name: Human-Following-Robot-with-Gesture-Control-ROS-2-Humble-
items.description: A ROS 2-based autonomous robot that detects humans using a depth camera, interprets hand gestures to Start/Stop following, and maintains a safe distance using a proportional controller. This project was developed on a Kobuki (TurtleBot 2) base with an Orbbec Astra Camera.

items.name: Astratinker_bot
items.description: The robot's brain is powered by an FPGA  that reads and processes the sensor data and controls the actuators. Challenges Building AB from scratch using an FPGA, understanding and implementing single-cycle RISC-V CPU design, and creating a hardware-software co-design using Verilog HDL to unveil the powerful parallel processing capabilities of FPGAs.

items.name: Robot-Camera-Pick-and-Place-System
items.description: This repository consists of the integrated software solution for Robot Food Assembly in the Phase 2 of the Soft Hybrid Gripper Project. ROS framework was used as middleware to capture inputs from Astra depth camera and to control output of the Universal Robot.

items.name: mycobot_320pi_R6A
items.description: Research substrate for the MyCobot 320 Pi: ROS2/TCP control, Gazebo Harmonic digital twin, hand-teleoperation (Astra+Wilor), DREAM pose estimation (VGG keypoints), and intrinsic camera calibration. Roadmap: Isaac Sim + VLA fine-tuning.

items.name: Aaroh
items.description: A modular Arduino program for a differential drive bot mounted with a robotic arm having 3 Degrees-of-Freedom, controlled wirelessly via Dabble App. This program was developed for Aaroh - the staircase climbing bot of DRC-SPIT's team Astra, who competed in Technice 14.O, IIT Guwhati.
